result:
**QA-38198 verdict: FAILED**, because of the open linked bug APPS-58195. Every data assertion passes. The report is at `results/2026-11-17/QA-38198-report.md`.

I ran the case in full on dev: Sephora account, Sephora brand with Authorized Data, all 7 channels, story 162866, section "Social Activity - Year to Date".

| Metric | Sum of channel rows | Donut |
|---|---|---|
| Impressions | 9,116,291,161 | 9B |
| Video Views | 2,479,752,842 | 2B |
| Engagements | 22,095,300 | 22M |
| New Followers (positive rows only) | 1,017,414 | 1M |

- **Tooltip:** the donut hover tooltip stays empty in headless Chrome, so I couldn't read it. I took each donut's total from the chart's own data (arc value ÷ share) instead, and it matches the sums.
- **APPS-58195:** the bug did not reproduce. No negative Video Views or Engagements for Facebook or Twitter. I couldn't re-check its current status, since there's no Jira in this run, so the FAILED verdict follows the open-bug policy.
- **Incident:** my first Run Report click hit the Zendesk "Contact us" widget that overlaps the button, so no report started. A local network change also dropped the connection, and the tool call hung for about 35 minutes. After hiding the widget, the report built in about 15 seconds, so this was a tooling problem, not an app render hang.

I did no skill or registry maintenance; the report notes the widget workaround for `harvest.sh`.
